source.name: Footy Headlines: Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya 26-27 Home and Away Kits Released
source.quote: Iraqi Stars League side Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya has revealed its new home and away kits for the 26-27 season, crafted by kit supplier Kelme.
source.note: Kit maker. The launch photos on this page show the royal-blue home shirt with the Kelme paw logo on the right chest and no commercial sponsor anywhere: centre front carries the gold Iraqi Stars League champions' badge (the league's own mark, not a sponsor), the left chest the club crest, one sleeve the ISL league patch, and the shorts and socks carry only the Kelme mark. The back is not shown in the launch gallery. Kelme Iraq's own Instagram post of 12 August 2026 (instagram.com/p/Db9M_FAnDju/) announces 'طقم نادي القوة الجوية للموسم 2026-2027 من Kelme' (Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya's 2026-2027 kit from Kelme).

summary: Kelme 2026-27 home kit, royal blue with white V-neck and cuff trim. The launch photos (Footy Headlines, 14 August 2026) show no commercial sponsor on the shirt: the centre front carries the gold Iraqi Stars League champions' badge, the right chest the Kelme maker's mark, the left chest the club crest, one sleeve the ISL league patch, and plain shorts and socks with only the Kelme mark. Kelme has made the club's kits since a deal signed in July 2024 (Nakhel News/palms-news, 2024-07-06); the club plays the 2026-27 AFC Champions League Elite as Iraqi champions (IraqiNews, 2026-08-18). sponsorsComplete is false because the launch gallery does not show the back of the shirt and no announcement documents a back sponsor; in-season match imagery could not be checked from here.
